Wizards' own text keeps the symbol whole: the Murders at Karlov Manor Release Notes (Eric Levine, 2024-01-26, with the Ravnica: Clue Edition cards) and Gatherer have 'You may pay {W/B} a maximum of one time for each extort triggered ability.
